1579 is not a leap year (leap years are divisible by 4, but 1579 is not).  
Start date: 1579-03-02.  
Subtract 32 weeks = 224 days, plus 5 days = 229 days total.  
March has 31 days, so going back:  
From 1579-03-02 subtract 1 day → 1579-03-01, subtract remaining 228 days.  
February 1579 has 28 days.  
March 1 back 28 days → 1579-01-31.  
From 1579-01-31 back remaining 200 days (228 - 28 = 200).  
200 days back from 1579-01-31: go into 1578.  
1578 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
From 1579-01-31 back 31 days → 1578-12-31, remaining 169 days.  
From 1578-12-31 back 365 days (full non-leap year) → 1577-12-31, but that’s too much (365 > 169). Instead, subtract 169 days from 1578-12-31:  
December (31 days) → back 31 days → 1578-11-30, remaining 138.  
November (30) → back 30 → 1578-10-31, remaining 108.  
October (31) → back 31 → 1578-09-30, remaining 77.  
September (30) → back 30 → 1578-08-31, remaining 47.  
August (31) → back 31 → 1578-07-31, remaining 16.  
July (31) → back 16 days → 1578-07-15.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1578-07-15
